instruction: Review the existing calculator.py in the repository to understand its current functionality, structure, and any missing requirements before making changes.

decision: No code generated; existing file is a Tkinter GUI calculator with AST-based safe evaluation and inline assertions.
findings: Supports addition, subtraction, multiplication, division, unary plus/minus, decimals, keyboard input, clear, backspace, result formatting, and division-by-zero handling. Uses float conversion, so numeric precision is limited; GUI depends on Tkinter. No explicit user requirements beyond review were provided.
